footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to James River: after $2.4M of discontinued operations, $7.9M of preferred dividends. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 2.8% to $688M in 2025. Operating income was $50.5M, up from a $71.1M loss.
Net income was $39.6M, or $0.79 per share, after a $118M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was −$18.8M and free cash flow −$23.6M, versus −$252M; James River returned $2.0M through dividends.
sources: James River Group Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
